context.purpose: Assess planar pin-jointed elastic networks and named serviceability measurements from editable physical intent.
context.assumptions: SI m/N/Pa/m²; zero Cartesian restraints, straight axial bars, small deformation/strain; OpenSees3.8.0 through isolated OpenSeesPy3.8.0.0.
context.constraints: 2..40 nodes,1..80 members; independent stability and small-strain limits; no frames/nonlinearity/buckling/dynamics/general FEA.
context.inspection: Inspect signed member force/stress, displacement/reaction tables and named margins. Independent direct stiffness and global equilibrium verify every native response, with fresh-process retained-model reconstruction.
context.recovery: Correct located physical input, brace mechanisms, inspect native logs, revise explicit unmet measured limits/design, and use a fresh output directory; modified evidence fails verification.
